contact.name: Jolene Zywica
contact.evidence_quote: Jolene Zywica, PhD ... Jolene Zywica, PhD, is Chief Learning Officer at Opportunity Education (OE), where she ensures OE's products stay true to its mission and grounded in evidence. She has spent over 20 years designing and evaluating learning programs and technology, and supporting teachers in implementing them to help students become self-directed learners. Jolene lives in Pittsburgh with her family and loves the outdoors, swimming, and trying new things.
